title: VTC Directory — Card — Publish — payload
description: A member publishes their external card: their `public` values as a JSContact card they signed. The community serves it as signed and points its trust registry to it; it never signs or composes the card itself. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

expectedRevision.description: The card revision the member signed against. Where the card has changed since, the answer is `superseded` and nothing is published.

Response.title: VTC Directory — Card — Publish — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/card/publish/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/card/publish/0.1#response.

externalCard.description: `published`, with the digest of the card now served.
